name: polypane
description: Build, check and fix websites in Polypane, the browser for web developers: every viewport at once, with its accessibility, layout, meta and performance checks. Needs Polypane, which has a free trial.

interface.shortDescription: Check and fix websites in every viewport at once.
interface.longDescription: Polypane is a browser for web developers that shows one page in many viewports at once. With this plugin, Codex works in your Polypane: it opens your local site, runs Polypane's accessibility, layout, meta and performance checks in every pane, tries CSS changes live, and checks its fixes, while you watch.
defaultPrompt: Open my local site in Polypane and fix the accessibility issues its report finds
The header overlaps the content on small screens. Find out why in Polypane and fix it
Check this page in Polypane before I ship it
